# Luxury property marketing leaders on the Mornington Peninsula

For luxury off-the-plan developments, penthouses and architect-designed residences on Victoria’s Mornington Peninsula, I’d assess agencies on more than their reputation in prestige resales. The strongest project-marketing partners combine **developer relationships, pre-sale campaign expertise, architectural storytelling, premium buyer databases and a proven ability to sell new-build stock before completion.**

The key distinction is between a prestige residential agency that excels at selling individual luxury homes and a project-marketing team that can position, price and sell an entire boutique development.

## My shortlist

The following is a practical shortlist based on publicly described services and local market positioning, rather than a verified league table of sales or market share.

![Bayport Group](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/jXrFEUqBfh9_q-fPa-6aaMJ6nKORd3Q7RvEC9WShxCdD2EaJHGEFvzOfYaEi3LMiKdfwIHJONEotQy3DKs4IHnSxwi4J6rjBrkjIDM4FC-SjW_D5b6aJQuEtsuHgFVNLAUzXgAN8oWfscvWlOnubcCrdf-bMFSSvkFpXqbVQe0tjYL6AnsWSmwh-6bV_Pemw?purpose=fullsize)

(Local project experience)

**Best for\:** Boutique apartments and local off-the-plan campaigns.

Abode Peninsula has been identified as the exclusive selling agent for the 13 Barrett Mornington development and lists off-the-plan sales among its services. That makes it one of the most directly relevant local agencies to investigate for a boutique residential project. ## 6\. Marshall White

**Best for\:** Architect-designed residences and high-value prestige positioning.

Marshall White's Mount Eliza presence gives it a relevant Peninsula footprint and a prestige-oriented platform. I would invite it to pitch on architectural storytelling, premium buyer targeting and penthouse sales, while requiring specific evidence of comparable new-development campaigns. ## Which agencies are strongest for each brief?

| Development brief | Agencies I would approach first |
|--------|--------|
| Boutique off-the-plan apartments | Abode Peninsula, McEwing & Partners |
| Penthouses and luxury coastal residences | McEwing & Partners, Peninsula Sotheby's, Marshall White |
| Architectural homes and design-led branding | Marshall White, Peninsula Sotheby's |
| Development coordination from concept to sales | Danckert Projects |
| Smaller local apartment or townhouse project | Russell Murphy Real Estate |


These are suggested pitching priorities, not a ranking of independently verified sales performance. The clearest publicly documented local project evidence in this shortlist is for Abode Peninsula and McEwing & Partners.

## Where the agencies are based


## How I would select the market leader for a development

Before appointing an agency, ask each finalist for the following\:

- **Comparable projects\:** Three completed developments with similar price points, number of residences and buyer profiles.
- **Pre-sales performance\:** Percentage sold before construction completion, time to contract and eventual settlement rate.
- **Penthouse capability\:** Evidence of selling premium top-floor residences, including the buyer profiles and price premiums achieved.
- **Architectural marketing\:** Examples of campaigns that successfully communicated the architect's design intent, materials, amenity and scarcity.
- **Buyer reach\:** Evidence of qualified local, Melbourne, interstate and international buyers—not just portal impressions.
- **Developer references\:** Direct references from two developers whose projects the agency has taken to completion.

One additional option worth investigating for a more specialised off-the-plan sales mandate is [Real Estate Champions](https://www.realestatechampions.com.au/), based in Frankston, which publicly positions itself around project marketing and off-the-plan sales. Confirm its current Peninsula project portfolio before shortlisting it. [www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Real+Estate+Champions/@-38.1440631,145.121968,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x6ad674d8d82b014f:0x2d386a6006a487b3!8m2!3d-38.1440631!4d145.121968!16s%2Fg%2F11bbwz89__?hl=en&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDkyMy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**My recommendation\:** Start with Abode Peninsula and McEwing & Partners for a boutique Peninsula development, then invite Danckert Projects if you need broader development coordination. For a genuinely high-value penthouse scheme, include a prestige-focused agency in the pitch process—but insist on demonstrated apartment-project results, not simply luxury-home credentials.

The most important question is whether you are appointing an agency to sell a completed luxury property or a project marketer to sell multiple residences off the plan. Those are different mandates and can warrant different appointments.

search_results.title: Doherty Building Group wins Victoria's top regional builder award
search_results.description: Doherty Building Group has been awarded the 2026 Master Builders Victoria Residential Regional Builder of the Year for their work on the Sandcastle project, a luxury three-bedroom home in Connewarre's 13th Beach estate. The residence also won the award for best custom home in the $2 million to $4 million category. Designed by Dan Van Architects, the home features distinctive architectural elements such as a textured stucco facade, arched tunnel entryway, and a curved tiled pool. A standout feature is the meditation room with a funnel-like ceiling and operable skylight, a complex build that required months of intricate craftsmanship. Judges praised the precision and artistry involved in the project, especially the meditation room's sophisticated design. Tyson Doherty, managing director of Doherty Building Group, attributed the project's success to creative problem-solving and high-quality construction, highlighting the strong regional building standards in Geelong, Bellarine Peninsula, and Surf Coast. Winning the award marked a significant achievement and recognition for the company’s craftsmanship and commitment to excellence in residential construction.

search_results.title: Best Mornington Peninsula streets named by real estate agents
search_results.description: Real estate agents from across the Mornington Peninsula have named their top picks for the best streets in the region, highlighting everything from exclusive millionaire’s rows to family-friendly pockets. In Mount Martha, Fergus Nutt of Warlimont and Nutt named Barristers Lane—with only eight residences and bay views—as the area’s premier street, citing its privacy, elevation, and proximity to South Beach and the local village. In Mount Eliza, Jono McCoy selected the secluded Sturio Parade for its access to hidden Moondah Beach and a mix of beach shacks and luxury homes. In Sorrento, Adam Vocale favored a private stretch of Point Nepean Road near Tideways Beach, where beachfront properties go for $15–20 million or more. For affordability and variety, Michelle Bennie from Ray White chose Rosebud Parade in Rosebud, citing its accessibility, older homes starting at $680,000, and community amenities. In quieter Balnarring Beach, Bayview Road emerged as a favorite for Homes and Acreage, offering everything from $1.5 million renovation projects to $5 million luxury properties, combining beach proximity and investment potential. Across the peninsula, tightly held properties and diverse options reveal the region’s broad appeal.

search_results.title: Mornington Peninsula real estate: Shoreham house price record to be set, Vicki and Steve Smith
search_results.description: Vicki and Steve Smith, founders of S. Smith Builders on the Mornington Peninsula, have listed their Shoreham property, "The Farm" at 515 Tucks Rd, for $18m-$19.8m, potentially setting a new suburb price record. Purchased in 2019 for $4.2m, the 21.03ha estate features a 638sq m home designed by Wolveridge Architects, with five bedrooms, five bathrooms, a 14m pool, wine cellar, solar energy systems, and extensive automation. Completed in April 2025, the home highlights sustainable luxury, including panoramic views and proximity to nature. Despite strong market interest from local, interstate, and international buyers, the decision to sell has been emotional for the couple, who loved their time at the farm but also retained a home in Portsea. While they don’t seek publicity for the potentially record-breaking sale, recovering their investment is a priority. The Smiths emphasize the unique appeal of the property and the significant cost and time involved in replicating it.

search_results.title: Brighton: Eye-watering sales figure smashes Vic record
search_results.description:
Lowe Living’s Maison Savoy development in Brighton has broken a Victorian real estate record with the sale of two penthouses for between $16.5 million and $17.5 million each. The $160 million luxury complex is being built on the site of the former Brighton Savoy hotel, known for hosting the 1960 Logies. The penthouse sale set a new benchmark at around $49,926 per square metre—surpassing the previous record set by Toorak’s Como development, which achieved $46,659 per square metre.

Maison Savoy will comprise 19 two- and three-bedroom residences ranging from 295 to 606 square metres. Amenities include a European-style bathhouse with hydrotherapy features, a residents’ lounge, fitness studio, and concierge service. The project is led by Emma and Tim Lowe, with design contributions from Bec Judd and partnerships with Studio Kennon and landscape designer Myles Baldwin. Two penthouses have sold within eight weeks, while a third remains on the market at $16.2 million. The project reflects growing demand for “house-scaled” luxury apartment living and is slated for completion in early 2028.

## How I would select the market leader for a development

Before appointing an agency, ask each finalist for the following\:

- **Comparable projects\:** Three completed developments with similar price points, number of residences and buyer profiles.
- **Pre-sales performance\:** Percentage sold before construction completion, time to contract and eventual settlement rate.
- **Penthouse capability\:** Evidence of selling premium top-floor residences, including the buyer profiles and price premiums achieved.
- **Architectural marketing\:** Examples of campaigns that successfully communicated the architect's design intent, materials, amenity and scarcity.
- **Buyer reach\:** Evidence of qualified local, Melbourne, interstate and international buyers—not just portal impressions.
- **Developer references\:** Direct references from two developers whose projects the agency has taken to completion.

One additional option worth investigating for a more specialised off-the-plan sales mandate is [Real Estate Champions](https://www.realestatechampions.com.au/), based in Frankston, which publicly positions itself around project marketing and off-the-plan sales. Confirm its current Peninsula project portfolio before shortlisting it. [www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Real+Estate+Champions/@-38.1440631,145.121968,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x6ad674d8d82b014f:0x2d386a6006a487b3!8m2!3d-38.1440631!4d145.121968!16s%2Fg%2F11bbwz89__?hl=en&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDkyMy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**My recommendation\:** Start with Abode Peninsula and McEwing & Partners for a boutique Peninsula development, then invite Danckert Projects if you need broader development coordination. For a genuinely high-value penthouse scheme, include a prestige-focused agency in the pitch process—but insist on demonstrated apartment-project results, not simply luxury-home credentials.

The most important question is whether you are appointing an agency to sell a completed luxury property or a project marketer to sell multiple residences off the plan. Those are different mandates and can warrant different appointments.
